purpose: The one seam through which GilbPlatform client code gets its credential headers, so the same client works with any signed-in session and never sends a credential to a host outside the platform.
namedChanges: 0.1.2. `NotSignedInError` carries the platform's 401 sentence as `platformSentence`; new `RequestRefusedError` and `errorForUnauthorized(res, invalidate)` (src/unauthorized.ts): a 401 that names a DPoP proof fault keeps the token; the signin peer is ^0.2.6. New `signedSend(fetchImpl?)` (src/signedSend.ts): the signed `send` picture-set takes
the sentence of `OriginNotAllowedError` (line 51): `add http://localhost:5197 to GilbPlatform's FIRST_PARTY_ORIGINS?` is `add this app's origin to GilbPlatform's FIRST_PARTY_ORIGINS?`
comments that name a host are reworded, no code changed
